name: AnimatedOpacity
description: A widget that automatically animates changes in opacity of its child over a given duration. Useful for fade-in and fade-out effects without using a StatefulWidget manually.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose opacity will be animated.

properties.name: opacity
properties.description: The target opacity value. 0.0 means fully transparent and 1.0 means fully opaque.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate opacity changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating the opacity changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut
